title: Oil Infused British Chicken Wrap
description: A satvik friendly, earthy and springy dish featuring birds eye chillies, perfect for a sick day, wrapped in a lotus leaf wrap.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, birds eye chillies, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the score fat in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the chicken mixture until browned.
Add the olive oil to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the chicken cool slightly.
Spoon the chicken mixture onto the center of each lotus leaf.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the chicken.
Fold the lotus leaves over the filling to form a wrap.
Serve the wraps hot and enjoy.
